chunks: Those who slander believing men and women for what they have not done, will bear the burden of calumny and clear iniquity.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of falsely accusing believers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Ahzab is often linked to the incident of Al-Ifk, illustrating the severe spiritual consequences of baseless slander against the faithful. It underscores that false accusations not only constitute a blatant lie (buhtan) but also a distinct, clear sin (ithm mubin) that carries heavy divine retribution, serving as a warning for the community to protect the honor of believers.
